bio: I am Farhan Sayed, an AI & Full-Stack Engineer dedicated to building the future. I specialize in architecting high-impact government platforms, leading national award-winning startup ventures, and deploying enterprise-grade AI systems. Driven by relentless ambition, my mission is to transform complex problems into elegant, highly scalable solutions that bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and real-world impact.

timeline.title: B.Sc IT Graduate & MCA Candidate
timeline.description: Graduated with a B.Sc. in Information Technology in 2026 from VSIT Mumbai and currently pursuing MCA. Actively engaged in developing government-backed projects and scalable startup ideas while leading 120+ members as President of the CSI student branch.

timeline.title: Internships & AI/Cloud Focus
timeline.description: Completed IBM SkillsBuild internships in Front-End, AI, and Cloud dev. Worked as a Full Stack Developer Intern at META Craftlab and an AI Intern at Evoastra Ventures.

timeline.title: Hackathon Successes
timeline.description: Finalist at Smart India Hackathon for the AYUSH Startup Portal. Secured 3rd place at the National-Level CSI Ideathon with 'MediScan'.

timeline.title: Cybersecurity & Data
timeline.description: Interned in Cyber Security & Digital Forensics at Cyber Secured India, and set to intern in Data Science/Analytics at Imarticus Learning.

timeline.title: Innovation & AI Hustle
timeline.description: Won Smart India Hackathon 2025 with a Disaster Education System. Finalist in The Open Group INITIATE EA Competition with 'GovBuy'. Currently working as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Ridlan AI Foundation (Piramal Finance), scaling frontend and backend systems.
